## GET `/103/replication/capabilities/symmetrix`

**Tier:** T0  

Capability checker to see if SnapVX or SRDF will execute on the arrays. Checks are also made for capabilities for SRDF/Metro, virtual witness, MetroDR, snapshot policies, VASA Replication Groups

**Responses:** `200` OK → `replicationSymmetrixCapabilityList` · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `500` Internal Server Error

## DELETE `/103/replication/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}/metrodr/{environmentName}`

**Tier:** T3  

Removes an SRDF/MetroDR environment configuration from the array. This operation will remove one SRDF group from the MetroDR Environment and leave the remaining groups in place - resulting in Metro with DR on either the R1 or R2 side. Default behaviour is to remove the MetroR2 to DR SRDF Group

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `symmetrixId` | path | string | yes |  |
| `environmentName` | path | string | yes |  |
| `remove_r1_dr_rdfg` | query | string |  | Value that removes the MetroR1 to DR SRDF Group from the Environment instead |
| `force` | query | string |  | Value that set the force flag |
| `symforce` | query | string |  | Value that set the symforce flag |

**Responses:** `204` No Content · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `404` Not Found · `500` Internal Server Error

## POST `/103/replication/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}/rdf_group`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

create an SRDF group between two arrays. The port structures in the request payload signal to Unisphere which remote array to create the group with. If the array is not currently known then the full port object must be populated. Remote port objects can be gotten from the rdf_director/port GET for remote_ports.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `symmetrixId` | path | string | yes | The storage array ID |

**Request body** (required): `rdfGroupCreate`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `executionOption` | string (enum: `SYNCHRONOUS`, `ASYNCHRONOUS`) |  |
| `label` | string | The label for the SRDF group |
| `local_rdfg_number` | integer (int32) | The SRDF group number from the local System perspective |
| `local_ports` | array of `rdfDirectorPort` | Local SRDF ports to be used in the SRDF group |
| `remote_rdfg_number` | integer (int32) | The SRDF group number from the remote System perspective |
| `remote_ports` | array of `rdfDirectorPort` | Remote SRDF ports to be used in the SRDF group |
| `metro_witness` | boolean | Create the group as an SRDF/Metro Witness group |

**Responses:** `201` Created → `rdfGroup` · `202` Accepted · `400` Bad Request · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `409` Conflict · `500` Internal Server Error

## DELETE `/103/replication/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}/storagegroup/{storageGroupId}/snapshot/{snapshotId}/generation/{generationNumber}`

**Tier:** T3  

This call terminates a snapshot generation. If the snapshot generation is restored, the restored session will be terminated. If there is no restore session associated with the snapshot generation, the generation itself will be terminated. If it is not known if the generation is restored before issuing the DELETE command, performing a GET for the generations after a successful DELETE will indicate if the generation still exists (a restore was terminated) or if the generation is gone (the original generation was terminated)

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `symmetrixId` | path | string | yes | The storage array ID |
| `storageGroupId` | path | string | yes | The Storage Group name |
| `snapshotId` | path | string | yes | The Snapshot name |
| `generationNumber` | path | integer (int32) | yes | The Generation number |
| `force` | query | string |  | Value to set the force flag |
| `symforce` | query | string |  | Value to set the symforce flag |
| `star` | query | string |  | Value to set the star flag |

**Responses:** `204` No Content · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `404` Not Found · `500` Internal Server Error
